method: isolated softmax predictor-only using exact MULTIPULSE-018 probs formula and TWIN-SUPERVISION-021 frozen weights from corrected 022 evidence; one public 128/64 feature vector, 30k warmups + 50k timed calls per process
limitations: Not a real SLM, full game-policy, navigation replanning, native host, or end-to-end inference. No model weights included in benchmark script. Original benchmark ran with a minimal fixture holding the exact training weights because the container has no network to fetch the repository; numerical predictor assertion passed on the same weights and feature vector.
